description.en: Session handoff & context management: export/resume/status structured handoff documents so a fresh session continues seamlessly, active context pruning (acp_* tools via the official compaction API with model-authored summaries), session trash/restore/purge, and model routes for one model across vendors/plans.
description.zh: 会话交接与上下文管理：导出/恢复/查看结构化交接文档，让新会话无缝续接；集成主动上下文裁剪（acp_* 工具，基于官方 compaction API 与模型自写摘要）；附带会话回收/恢复/清除与跨供应商模型路由。
